info.name: SMC Certificates, NOC and Advertisement permission (CLEAN_CERT, HEALTH_NOC, ADV_PERM) - Local
info.description:
The three Sangamner services that run on the trade license APIs, against the local stack (see LOCAL_RUN.md and ../README.md, section 6):

- `CLEAN_CERT` Cleanliness certificate
- `HEALTH_NOC` No Objection Certificate (Health License)
- `ADV_PERM` Advertisement / hoarding / flex / flags permission

**Before the first run** run folder 0: every request must pass. If a workflow is missing, load it with `load-permit-workflows.ps1`; if a master is missing, merge the MDMS files of ../README.md and restart egov-mdms-service.

**Run** a folder top to bottom, or with the Collection Runner (folders 1 to 5 each create one application and take it to the issued certificate). The collection variable `propertyId` must be a property without unpaid property tax or water dues.

The request bodies of the workflow steps are built in the collection pre-request script: it reads the application with `_search` (waiting for the persister), sets the action and comment and sends it back, as the employee screen does. The headers starting with `X-TL-` tell the scripts which user and role act, which action is taken, and what the test expects; the services ignore them.

There is no gateway locally: the user is sent in `RequestInfo.userInfo` and its roles are trusted. TLSU1 is given the role each step needs (`X-TL-Role`), including `TP_HOD`.

item.name: 1. Cleanliness certificate (CLEAN_CERT)
item.description: Citizen applies; clerk verifies and inspects; License HoD recommends; Chief Officer approves; LOI of Rs. 1,000 is paid; the certificate is valid one year from the approval.

request.description: Created and submitted in one request, as the citizen form does. Property tax and water dues of {{propertyId}} are checked here.
A rejection needs its reason in the comment.
Clerk verifies the documents.
Clerk records the inspection and forwards to the HoD.
HoD recommends to the Chief Officer.
Approval raises the LOI (demand) and sets the validity: one year from today.
The LOI: the bill of the certificate fee. Waits till the application is saved in PENDINGPAYMENT.
Counter payment of the whole bill by TLSU1 as TL_CEMP. collection-services then publishes the payment; tl-services consumes it and moves the application on.
Waits for the payment to be consumed. The certificate has its number and is valid approval date + 1 year - 1 day.

item.description: Clinic of 2,000 sq. ft.: fee is the higher of Rs. 5,000 and Rs. 3 per sq. ft. = Rs. 6,000; valid 3 years. Five levels: clerk, Town Planning HoD, License HoD, Chief Officer.

The LOI: the bill of the NOC fee. Waits till the application is saved in PENDINGPAYMENT.

Valid 3 years from the approval.

item.name: 3. Health NOC of an offensive business: publicity, objection, hearing
item.description: Chicken / mutton / fish sale. The License HoD marks it offensive: LOI of Rs. 2,000 for the paper publicity, then objections are awaited for 7 days. Here an objection is recorded and heard, so the run needs no waiting. After the Chief Officer approves, the NOC fee of Rs. 1,000 is paid.
